# USOS answer profile "Dom" (docs/answer-profiles.md).
# No disk or boot loader keys: partitioning always stays in the installer.
d-i cdrom-detect/try-usb boolean true
d-i debian-installer/locale string pl_PL.UTF-8
d-i keyboard-configuration/xkb-keymap select pl
d-i netcfg/get_hostname string usos-pc
d-i netcfg/hostname string usos-pc
d-i netcfg/get_domain string
d-i passwd/root-login boolean false
d-i passwd/user-fullname string Tester
d-i passwd/username string tester
d-i passwd/user-password-crypted password $6$usosgoldensalt00$SyGWlOqBZhYRPvSLnnk3UcylmKhx/IEvRvmMOppqMHb1dIYLyj0imHkABG5j0cZ8dPzoatvtYoNC3w8ihlK.O0
d-i time/zone string Europe/Warsaw
